diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong upward trend (a net rise of ~69% of its level). There is little seasonal structure. The series is quite predictable: its energy concentrates in a few structured frequencies. The series reads as non-stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (20 points, ~1% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is moderate (Kendall tau 0.407), which favours a weighted combination.
